plugin.name: Version_Check
plugin.author: Nick Gammon
plugin.purpose: Checks for a new version of MUSHclient
plugin.description:
MUSHclient now looks for new versions itself, with or without this plugin: see Help > Check for Updates, and the option in Global Preferences. So this plugin no longer does anything by itself, and there's no need to keep it. It stays so that a world that has it installed still loads without complaint.
To check right now, type: version_check
